translations.web: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
translations.bsb: The LORD’s eyes keep watch over knowledge, but He frustrates the words of the faithless.
translations.kjv: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
translations.asv: The eyes of Jehovah preserve him that hath knowledge; But he overthroweth the words of the treacherous man.
